''See also: [[Kelarac Timeline]]''

== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac, known by the title 'Collector of Souls,' is a [[Great Elder]] distinguished by his lack of a specific domain. Unlike his siblings, he wanders through various territories, gathering power from humans by granting their wishes in exchange for valuable items such as artifacts, relics, blood, sanity, or personal loyalty. While he is a shrewd and dangerous bargainer whose deals often result in the ruin of the other party, some groups like the [[Sleepless]] view him as a potential bridge for interaction between humans and non-humans due to his willingness to provide support. He maintains a philosophy that free men are more valuable than slaves because they possess the ability to bargain. Historically, Kelarac's true appearance is known only to the Emperor. He has been described as appearing like a fashionable [[Heartlander]] with a trimmed beard, numerous rings, and jewels, though he is notably characterized by a polished [[steel]] blindfold bolted to his face. In other manifestations, he has appeared as a massive ocean creature with the form of a shark and stony skin, large enough to resemble an island. He is currently said to be chained within a drowned city beneath the [[Aion]], though he remains active. Individuals may attempt to summon his attention through focused [[Intent]] and a sacrifice of something valuable tossed into the [[Aion]], though success is never guaranteed. He possesses vast treasure vaults containing various awakened items and maintains powerful servants that can act on his behalf.}}

== Appearance ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac is a massive, shark-headed ocean creature with stony, bronze skin and a dorsal fin the size of a tower. He possesses a [[steel]]-shrouded head featuring a rusted metal blindfold bolted into his sockets, and he has a gold-capped smile with silvery teeth. His physical form includes jeweled, ringed fingers and a glossy brown braid.}}

== Personality ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|A shrewd bargainer and the Collector of Souls, Kelarac is known for making deals that often doom the other party. He possesses a deep and fathomless mind, claiming to know the secrets of time, worlds, the future, and human intent. He is motivated by an intent of greed and possession, often granting wishes in exchange for items of value or souls.}}

== Relationships ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac made a bargain with [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]], whom he has marked and provided an Awakened blade to. He is rumored to reside alongside [[Nakothi]], and his presence can be sensed by the Emperor and [[Jerri]]. Other connections include [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]], to whom he gave a musical gift, and [[Estyr]], who intends to send [[Calder]] down to him.}}

== Abilities ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac is a [[Reader of Memory]] who uses dreams and possesses infinite knowledge. He can take the form of a stone shark and utilizes a mark that allows for the sensing of [[Intent]]. His power is also linked to an Awakened blade and can be found living within [[Shera]].}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The Shark of Aion}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|Kelarac is a living ocean creature of such immense scale that it can blot out the sun, possessing a bronze and craggy body reminiscent of an intricate statue with skin like an ancient stone wall.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 20</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 23</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 24</ref> This entity features a shark's head filled with silvery, triangular teeth, a dorsal fin as large as a tower, and a gold-ringed hand.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" /> Equipped with a mark used to sense [[Intent]] and ghostly [[chains]], Kelarac is an entity associated with an Elder whose power involves an [[Intent]] of greed and possession.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c20" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" /> Described as a fool rather than a puppet, Kelarac warned [[Calder]] about the limitations of the Awakened blade and noted that a law beyond this world binds even their kind.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c22">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" /> Despite these attributes, Kelarac needs [[Calder]] and possesses thin caramel-skinned hands alongside a glossy brown braid.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c24" /><ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c25">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 25</ref>}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|War against Kelarac}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|The conflict known as Kelarac's war serves as another name for the battle fought against Kelarac.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26">''Of Kings and Killers'', chapter 26</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">1</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|[[Kelarac]]'s war is one name for the battle against [[Kelarac]].<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c26" />}}</li>
</ul></div>

{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac is a person who enjoys purchasing people and has previously been blinded and nailed to the floor of the [[Aion Sea]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 6</ref> He marks his favorite slaves, a practice that included marking [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c6" /><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 20</ref> While [[Estyr]] mentions him, [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] has been accused of consorting with Kelarac and is allegedly enthralled by him, acting as a pawn.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c8">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 8</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c14">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 14</ref> Holding the reins of [[The Empire|the Empire]], Kelarac maintains influence over the Emperor.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c10">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 10</ref> He gave [[Jyrine Tessella Marten|Jyrine]] a gift featuring a muted and happy song.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c20" /> As a threat that the city must fight, Kelarac is open to negotiation and capable of offering deals.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 22</ref><ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 24</ref> [[Urg’naut|Urg'naut]] has stated he is not Kelarac, though he mentioned that Kelarac is coming.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c23">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 23</ref> Kelarac may have restored [[Imperial Steward Calder Marten|Calder Marten]] to life and is described as a fool by [[Loreli]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c24" /> The first challenge in the war against Kelarac involved fitting everyone onto [[Navigator ships]], as [[Nathanael Bareius|Bareius]] prepared for battle with the shark-like creature.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 25</ref> This entity can take a stone shark form and possesses a rusted [[steel]] blindfold bolted to his face.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}

=== {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Of Killers and Kings}} ===
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|Kelarac was devoured from the inside by energy that turned on its own origin, an entity that serves as a source of power for [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" /> He claimed that he could be placed within an object and cast into the ocean to remain a non-threat for centuries.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 26</ref> Although Kelarac possesses an arsenal of weapons, his power exists only within [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" /> Kelarac is now dead.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c27">''Of Killers and Kings'', chapter 27</ref>}}
<div class="wv-facts mw-collapsible mw-collapsed"><div class="wv-facts-head mw-collapsible-toggle">Sourced facts <span class="wv-facts-count">6</span></div>

<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] is a source of energy for [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c25" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]] claims he can be put into an object and thrown into the ocean to become no threat for centuries.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>
<li>{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[Kelarac]]'s power lives only in [[Shera]].<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c26" />}}</li>

== Notable quotes ==
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness|“Kelarac is still free to act,” Jerri said.<ref name="ee-sea-02-of-dawn-and-darkness-c3" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“I’m pleased to see you again, Reader of Memory,” Kelarac said.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c17" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Kelarac keeps his bargains,” Jerri responded.<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c19" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers|“Kelarac is alive and we think he’s coming here. The sky is…wide open.”<ref name="ee-sea-03-of-kings-and-killers-c23" />}}
* {{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|It cost Kelarac to do this,” Jorin went on. “In fuel and in risk.<ref name="ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings-c22" />}}
